errors.quote: Freya wanted to answer, “Not at all.”
errors.wrong: "Ніяк" means "You can't" / "No way", in reply to how to succeed with four children. "Not at all" reads like a reply to "Do you have children?", as if she has none.

errors.quote: Freya had already left such questions unanswered.
errors.wrong: The original says that by now Freya habitually ignored such questions. The pluperfect suggests she had already ignored this or earlier ones in some completed past.
